entities.summary: Mbandzeni, a notable figure in the history of Eswatini, associated with Colonial Concessions and British Protectorate (1868–1907). Preceded by Concessions Era and Land Alienation. Their legacy influenced British Protectorate of Swaziland and Sobhuza II Privy Council 1926.
